module.name: roksbnkctl-bnk-adopt
module.description: Adopt an EXISTING IBM Cloud ROKS cluster over an existing Transit Gateway and install BIG-IP Next for Kubernetes on it. The cluster is registered, never created — and never destroyed.

required.name: prefix
required.description: Prefix for resource names roksbnkctl creates (e.g. acme-eu).

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Name or ID of the EXISTING ROKS cluster to adopt. It is never created and never destroyed by this blueprint.

required.name: region
required.description: Region the cluster lives in. Inherits from the selected credential template.

required.name: resource_group
required.description: IBM Cloud resource group. Inherits from the selected credential template.

required.name: existing_transit_gateway
required.description: The EXISTING Transit Gateway the cluster's VPC is reached over. `cluster register` attaches the VPC to it; a VPC already attached is adopted, not re-created.

optional.name: registry_cos_name
optional.description: Overrides the registry COS instance `cluster register` looks for. Blank = probe <prefix>-registry-cos, <cluster>-registry-cos, <cluster>-cos.

optional.name: manifest_version
optional.description: BNK manifest release to install. Blank = the roksbnkctl default.

optional.name: bigip_url
optional.description: BIG-IP management URL for the BNK CIS controller (optional).

optional.name: bigip_username
optional.description: BIG-IP username for CIS (optional).

optional.name: bigip_password
optional.description: BIG-IP password for CIS (optional).

optional.name: cos_instance
optional.description: COS instance holding the FAR auth key + subscription JWT. Blank = bnk-supply-chain.

optional.name: cos_bucket
optional.description: Bucket holding the FAR auth key + subscription JWT. Blank = bnk-artifacts. Account-suffixed buckets (bnk-artifacts-<account>) must be named explicitly.

optional.name: cos_region
optional.description: Region of that bucket. Blank = us-south.

optional.name: far_auth_file
optional.description: Object name of the FAR auth tarball in the bucket. Blank = f5-far-auth-key.tgz.

optional.name: subscription_jwt_file
optional.description: Object name of the subscription JWT in the bucket. Blank = subscription.jwt.

optional.name: registry_target
optional.description: Mirror backend: generic (a private OCI registry such as Harbor) or icr.

optional.name: registry_generic_host
optional.description: The mirror's host — for an air-gapped cluster this is its PRIVATE IP or DNS name, reached over the Transit Gateway.

optional.name: registry_repo_prefix
optional.description: Project / repository prefix inside the mirror (a Harbor project, an Artifactory repo key).

optional.name: registry_username
optional.description: Username the mirror is pushed to and pulled from.

optional.name: registry_password
optional.description: Password / access token for that user. Stored base64 in the workspace config, never logged.

optional.name: license_mode
optional.description: connected | disconnected | f5licenseproxy. Blank = connected.

optional.name: flp_external_url
optional.description: Licensing endpoint of an F5 License Proxy this cluster does NOT own — `flp output flp_external_endpoint` on the workspace that does.

optional.name: flp_root_ca_b64
optional.description: That proxy's base64 root CA, which the cluster's CWC must trust — `flp output flp_root_ca`. Already base64: it is stored verbatim.

optional.name: zone1_ext_vlan_cidr
optional.description: Zone 1: external VLAN CIDR (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone1_int_vlan_cidr
optional.description: Zone 1: internal VLAN CIDR (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone1_int_snat_cidr
optional.description: Zone 1: internal SNAT CIDR (SNAT addresses) (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone1_int_vip_cidr
optional.description: Zone 1: internal VIP CIDR (listener IPs) (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone1_external_selfip
optional.description: Zone 1: external self-IP (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone1_internal_selfip
optional.description: Zone 1: internal self-IP (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone2_ext_vlan_cidr
optional.description: Zone 2: external VLAN CIDR (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone2_int_vlan_cidr
optional.description: Zone 2: internal VLAN CIDR (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone2_int_snat_cidr
optional.description: Zone 2: internal SNAT CIDR (SNAT addresses) (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone2_int_vip_cidr
optional.description: Zone 2: internal VIP CIDR (listener IPs) (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone2_external_selfip
optional.description: Zone 2: external self-IP (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone2_internal_selfip
optional.description: Zone 2: internal self-IP (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone3_ext_vlan_cidr
optional.description: Zone 3: external VLAN CIDR (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone3_int_vlan_cidr
optional.description: Zone 3: internal VLAN CIDR (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone3_int_snat_cidr
optional.description: Zone 3: internal SNAT CIDR (SNAT addresses) (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone3_int_vip_cidr
optional.description: Zone 3: internal VIP CIDR (listener IPs) (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone3_external_selfip
optional.description: Zone 3: external self-IP (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

optional.name: zone3_internal_selfip
optional.description: Zone 3: internal self-IP (all 6 zone fields required for the zone to apply).

key_outputs.description: ID of the adopted ROKS cluster.

key_outputs.description: Name of the adopted ROKS cluster.
